name: (Mirage Dragon) Phantasmal Terror
text:
The dragon either temporarily appears to be in multiple places at once or grows to Gargantuan size to frighten their foes. Each enemy within a 120-foot emanation who can see the mirage dragon must attempt a DC 0 Will save save (with a DC equal to the dragon's Captivating Display).

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target Frightened 2 and can't is use reactions until the start of the dragon's next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but Frightened 3.
